properties.description: End to end against a registry server, which holds no tree and so cannot measure: a pointer-attached client and a bare --remote client with --tree-root send measured checksums for link_artifact, set_artifact_checksum, set_artifact_checksums and reconcile_artifacts; the reply's `measurement` block names the client and the root; a client with no root measures nothing and says `no_root`; an unmeasurable accept is refused locally in the server's wording and nothing is sent; an item already carrying a checksum passes through untouched. 7 tests. 6 were observed FAILING on main's client first (the behaviour), 1 (pass-through) already passing.
properties.findings: 2026-10-10, worktree client-measures at f792e88dc: 7 passed, 0 failed. The six behaviour tests were run against main's client (7d135a86b) first and failed there: the server refused the checksum-less calls by name. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: The remote client measures the folder's own files and the tree-less server records them as asserted
